title: zaro 0.0.1
text: Arrow-backed Zarr reader R. Implements Zarr specification directly using Arrow C++ filesystem access, compression codecs, byte buffers. dependency zarr-python Zarr-specific C/Rust library. S7 class ZaroMeta parsed array group metadata, uniform representation across Zarr V2 V3. Store abstraction layer ArrowStore (local, S3, GCS via Arrow FileSystem), VSIStore (HTTP fallback S3 via gdalraster), ReferenceStore (Kerchunk JSON references), VirtualiZarrStore (Parquet manifest reference stores). Designed future backends (Icechunk) without changing read pipeline. Codec pipeline normalised across V2 V3. V2’s single compressor plus filters list mapped V3-style codec chains decode path uniform.

title: zaro 0.0.1
text: Parse .zarray, .zgroup, .zattrs metadata. Consolidated metadata via .zmetadata - single HTTP request retrieves metadata arrays V2 store. Numpy dtype string parsing (<f4, >i2, |u1, etc.) endianness detection. _ARRAY_DIMENSIONS convention dimension names (xarray compatibility). dimension_separator handling (dot-separated slash-separated chunk keys). fill_value coercion JSON strings ("NaN", "Infinity") R numeric values. sanitize_json() handles Python-flavoured JSON bare NaN, Infinity, -Infinity values invalid strict JSON.

title: zaro 0.0.1
text: New VirtualiZarrStore backend directory-layout Parquet reference stores produced VirtualiZarr. provide Zarr-style access existing archival files (NetCDF, HDF5, GRIB) without reformatting. Metadata layer (.zmetadata) fetched via curl - GDAL-free. Chunk manifests (refs.N.parq shards) loaded via arrow::read_parquet() lazy per-variable loading environment-based caching. C-order linearization maps chunk grid indices manifest row positions stores without explicit chunk key columns. Inline data support via raw column manifests (used coordinate variables whose data stored directly Parquet rather byte-range references). Byte-range reads source files via byte_range_read() supporting Arrow S3/GCS, gdalraster VSI, curl HTTP - full chain GDAL-free using curl. URI scheme: virtualizarr://https://example.com/dataset.parq virtualizarr:///local/path/dataset.parq. Tested BRAN2023 ocean temperature (5479 time steps, 51 depth levels, 1500x3600 spatial grid, 104 manifest shards, NCI THREDDS byte-range serving).
